bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_qfd_band_lanes #(.NL(4), .LNK(0), .TREE_LAT(7), .RDMEM(1), .BANR(1)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv physical/ref_tile/qfd_sp_band_lanes_q4_m5/src/rtl/qwen_sys/lane_band_20261008/ot_qfd_band_lanes.sv physical/ref_tile/qfd_sp_band_lanes_q4_m5/src/rtl/hdc/ot_qwen_me_spine_h_w12.sv physical/ref_tile/qfd_sp_band_lanes_q4_m5/src/rtl/hdc/ot_qwen_w12_matvec.sv physical/ref_tile/qfd_sp_band_lanes_q4_m5/src/rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv physical/ref_tile/qfd_sp_band_lanes_q4_m5/src/rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv physical/ref_tile/qfd_sp_band_lanes_q4_m5/src/rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat_nr.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2.v && echo lint-ok

bench.name: band_exact_nl4
bench.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_0; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/qfd_sp_band_lanes_q4_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/qfd_sp_band_lanes_q4_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && JOBS=8 bash rtl/test/qwen_lane_band/run_band_lanes.sh {RUN}/bench/band_exact_nl4 -GNL=4 -GNOPS=3000 -GSEED=3 -GRDMEM=1 -GBANR=1
}
bench.note: [m5rr: run on the dace0dae3 snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/qfd_sp_band_lanes_q4_m5/src]
